exposure: Emergency CS after 8 h of active labor
Use of stored water for surgeon's pre-operative scrubbing
cohort: 500 women who underwent cesarean section at Korle Bu Teaching Hospital (KBTH), Accra, Ghana, from April to July 2017
finding: The incidence of surgical site infections following cesarean section at KBTH was 12.8%, with Staphylococcus aureus being the most common pathogen isolated.
